# DonorDock vs Network for Good Comparison

## **DonorDock**

### Best For
- Small to mid-sized nonprofits
- Organizations wanting affordable, straightforward donor management
- Teams needing user-friendly CRM without complexity

### Key Features
- **Donor Management**: Contact database, donation tracking, donor profiles
- **Communication Tools**: Email campaigns, task management, reminders
- **Reporting**: Donation reports, donor insights, custom fields
- **Integrations**: Limited but includes popular payment processors
- **Pricing**: ~$99-$149/month (flat rate, unlimited contacts)

### Pros
- Intuitive, easy-to-use interface
- Affordable flat-rate pricing
- Good customer support
- Quick setup and implementation
- Strong donor relationship tracking

### Cons
- Fewer advanced features
- Limited third-party integrations
- Less robust for complex organizations
- Smaller feature set compared to enterprise solutions

---

## **Network for Good**

### Best For
- Small to medium nonprofits
- Organizations wanting all-in-one fundraising platform
- Groups needing comprehensive donor engagement tools

### Key Features
- **Fundraising Tools**: Donation pages, peer-to-peer, event registration
- **Donor Management**: CRM, constituent tracking, segmentation
- **Marketing**: Email campaigns, social media integration
- **Coaching**: Fundraising coaching and training included
- **Reporting**: Comprehensive analytics and dashboards
- **Pricing**: Starts ~$99/month + transaction fees (typically 3-5%)

### Pros
- Comprehensive fundraising suite
- Built-in donation processing
- Fundraising coaching/support included
- Strong email marketing tools
- Good reporting capabilities

### Cons
- Transaction fees can add up
- Can be more expensive overall
- Learning curve for all features
- Some users report customer service inconsistencies

---

## **Key Differences**

| Factor | DonorDock | Network for Good |
|--------|-----------|------------------|
| **Primary Focus** | Donor CRM/Management | Full fundraising platform |
| **Pricing Model** | Flat monthly rate | Monthly fee + transaction fees |
| **Fundraising Pages** | Limited/through integrations | Built-in, robust |
| **Payment Processing** | Third-party integrations | Integrated |
| **Support/Training** | Standard support | Includes coaching |
| **Complexity** | Simpler, streamlined | More comprehensive |

## **Which Should You Choose?**

**Choose DonorDock if you:**
- Want simple, affordable donor management
- Already have fundraising tools in place
- Prefer predictable, flat-rate pricing
- Value ease of use over feature breadth

**Choose Network for Good if you:**
- Need comprehensive fundraising tools
- Want donation pages and processing integrated
- Value fundraising coaching/training
- Process significant online donation volume

Both are solid choices for small-to-medium nonprofits—your decision should be based on whether you need primarily donor management (DonorDock) or a complete fundraising platform (Network for Good).
